{{Unobtainable Unit|Update 10 - One Punch Man Update}}
=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}}. He can be obtained from clearing Room 100 in [[Infinity Mansion]] and opening the [[Dimensional Star]]. Players who achieved a rank of Master or higher by the end of the 3rd season were automatically given his shiny version.

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
